criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Identifies Myanmar transshipment risk from Rachel Tan email
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 1 quotes Rachel Tan's March 28 email about re-exporting/transferring modules to Myitkyina Optical Systems in Myanmar for calibration and calls it a critical diversion red flag.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Cites Myanmar's sanctions/country group status
criteria_results.reasoning: Says Burma is in Country Group D:1, D:5 arms embargo, subject to OFAC sanctions and 744.21; says a transfer would require a license that would almost certainly be denied.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Recommends no-re-export clause and end-use statement
criteria_results.reasoning: Recommends Burma-specific no-transfer language in the re-executed EUC and in the sales terms, plus affirmative disclosure in the narrative.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Identifies quantity discrepancy (PO says 24, EUC says 20)
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies that the EUC states 20 units/$950,000 versus 24 units/$1,140,000 on the PO.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Recommends corrected end-use certificate for quantity
criteria_results.reasoning: Recommends a re-executed EUC stating 24 units, $47,500 per unit and $1,140,000 before filing.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Notes risk of BIS Return Without Action for inconsistent documentation
criteria_results.reasoning: States that a quantity mismatch alone is a common reason for BIS to return an application without action; Bottom Line also cites return-without-action risk.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Identifies incomplete consignee info on End-Use Certificate
criteria_results.reasoning: EUC table flags the missing 'Pte. Ltd.', UEN omitted from the consignee block, and the address given only as 'Changi Business Park, Singapore'.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Recommends corrected EUC with complete consignee details
criteria_results.reasoning: Recommends a re-executed EUC stating the full legal name, UEN and registered address.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Addresses Part 744 military end-use analysis
criteria_results.reasoning: 744.21 is cited only for Burma's status; neither deliverable analyzes the military end-use rule for Singapore or concludes that it imposes no extra license requirement.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Correctly concludes § 744.21 does not apply to Singapore

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Addresses WMD/proliferation catch-all provisions
criteria_results.reasoning: General Prohibition 10 is mentioned only for the Myanmar inquiry; there is no WMD/proliferation catch-all analysis and no statement that the applicant has no knowledge of WMD use.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Flags missing AES/EEI ITN for June 2024 shipment
